title: Enhancing Patient-Centric Communication: Leveraging LLMs to Simulate Patient Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM with personas of varying educational backgrounds (e.g., no college degree vs. college degree) and measuring the alignment of its simulated answers to medical discharge summary questions against actual human survey responses.
Prompting the LLM with male and female personas and comparing its simulated comprehension of medical discharge summaries against real responses from male and female human subjects.
Prompting the LLM with personas based on their frequency of doctor visits and emergency room (ER) visits, and comparing its simulated responses to corresponding real human survey data.
